species: The hallmark pathological characteristic of human NCLs, including KCTD7 mutation–related NCLs, is the accumulation of highly autofluorescent and pigmented intracellular storage deposits.
tissue: To address this issue, we successfully ablated KCTD7 expression by CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing in HeLa cells, which exhibit abundant KCTD7 expression (Fig. 1A and fig. S1, A and B).
cell_type: Similar results were observed in KCTD7 KO U87-MG glioblastoma cells (fig. S3, A to M) and KCTD7 KD SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells (fig. S4, A to J).
disease_state: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are a group of the most common neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorders characterized by intracellular accumulation of ceroid in neurons.
